spots.text: I have typed it at last, every letter in its place: the book of my life, as it was, without a single error. It is one page long. I have left it in the machine for you. Do not correct anything.

secrets.name: The Last Page
secrets.text: Behind the shelves, one typewriter with one page in it, typed all the way to the bottom. Somebody finished.

meta.label: The Typing Pool
meta.blurb: Hundreds of typewriters on hundreds of desks, a sheet wound into every one. Each page has a few lines on it, and each stops mid-word.
